

# 1. Load the dataset
data(mtcars)
head(mtcars)

# 2. Explore the data
cor(mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt", "hp", "disp")])
pairs(mtcars[, c("mpg", "wt", "hp", "disp")], pch = 19, col = "steelblue")

# 3. Fit the multiple linear regression
model <- lm(mpg ~ wt + hp + disp, data = mtcars)

# 4. The results
summary(model)
confint(model)

# 5. Check the assumptions 
par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
plot(model)
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))

# 6. Predict mpg for a new car
new_car <- data.frame(wt = 3.0, hp = 120, disp = 200)
predict(model, newdata = new_car, interval = "prediction")
